## Problem

What user problem should this solve, and for whom?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the desired behaviour without assuming a particular implementation.

## Scope

List what is in scope and what is explicitly out of scope.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe a verifiable outcome.
- [ ] Describe another verifiable outcome.

## Design or technical considerations

Link relevant documentation, related issues, screenshots, or data/privacy considerations.

## Dependencies or blockers

List open questions, required decisions, or work that must happen first.
